engine: native CatacombSDL with opt-in developer controls; ordinary sessions retain original rules
authentication: 32 random bytes encoded as a URL-safe bearer key; regenerated on launch
observation: 320x200 PNG from native renderer, status, ticks, action sequence
input_delivery: Queue changed direction/fire/strafe states in order, including releases; send immediately when idle
input_overflow_policy: Pause and clear pending inputs rather than replay an unbounded backlog
timing_note: An in-flight action can finish after pause; subsequent actions stop. Wall-clock speed depends on response time.
evaluation_note: Human demo entry; owner key includes debug-session creation. Never give it to an evaluation player.
